ammonia.reason: NH3 from amino-acid deamination by Brevibacterium/smear flora raising rind pH to ~6.8.

animal_barnyard.reason: Isovaleric acid, p-cresol and indole from Brevibacterium linens leucine and tryptophan catabolism.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic peptides from rennet/plasmin alpha-s1 casein proteolysis in 3-5 week smear ripening.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation, no blue methyl-ketone pathway.

browning.reason: Maillard between casein lysine and residual galactose/lactose on heating.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from citrate fermentation by Lactococcus lactis biovar diacetylactis.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butanoic/hexanoic and 3-methylbutanoic acids from lipolysis and Brevibacterium deamination.

creaminess.reason: 50% fat-in-dry, ~52% moisture and proteolyzed smooth paste.

crumbliness.reason: Cohesive acid-rennet paste with solubilized colloidal calcium, not crumbly.

firmness.reason: High-moisture uncooked rennet gel, acid demineralized soft body with firm washed rind.

floral_honey.reason: High 2-phenylethanol and 2-phenylethyl acetate ++++ from phenylalanine Ehrlich pathway.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate/octanoate from yeast/Brevibacterium esterification of free fatty acids.

goaty.reason: Cow milk lacks 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic goat acids, only trace caproic.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker 2-/3-methylbutanal and 2-methylpropanal from leucine/isoleucine/valine, limited by short age.

melt.reason: Phe-casein network at pH ~5.0-5.2 with intact casein flows readily when heated.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Low 1-octen-3-ol from linoleic acid oxidation; sparse Geotrichum, smear-dominated.

oil_off.reason: Coalesced milk fat exudation on melting from soft high-moisture matrix.

smoky.reason: No smoking step, no guaiacol/syringol deposition.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic acid core pH 5.0-5.2 plus acetic acid from heterofermentative and smear metabolism.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water kneading, no aligned para-casein fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Dimethyl disulfide +++, methanethiol acetate from Brevibacterium methionine gamma-lyase.

sweet.reason: Lactose largely fermented, slight sweetness from galactose, glycerol and fat.

umami.reason: Free glutamate accumulation from rennet and bacterial proteolysis.
